# Warlock Process

> Package: `@warlock.js/process`

> App-owned child process supervision with verified identity and resource limits

## Skills

- [process](@warlock.js/process/skills/SKILL.md): Supervise owned child processes with `supervisor`, `ProcessNotOwnedError` and `UnsupportedProcessPlatformError`. Use for "start and stop a process", readiness checks, restart backoff, line-buffered output, IPC, graceful shutdown, pipelines or optional PTY sessions. Not this package → @warlock.js/queue for background jobs; @warlock.js/scheduler for cron; @warlock.js/ai-cli for coding-agent CLI adapters.
